title: Governance token minter()
detects: The address permitted to mint new supply. Common in governance tokens that have no Ownable owner at all.
knownFalseNegative: Reading minter() alone tells you an address, not whether it is dangerous. A minter behind a governance timelock is a normal design. Resolve admin-timelock before scoring it.
rationale: The second canonical reason this dictionary exists. Without this pattern, UNI's live mint authority is invisible and the token reads as fully renounced.
